note: Seed state committed so plan/flagged.html has a reproducible input. scripts/check_sources.mjs overwrites this file with the real result on every scheduled run of .github/workflows/plan-refresh.yml, and scripts/commit-refresh.sh commits the report together with the pages it feeds. An empty 'sources' list is what the page renders as 'no monitor run recorded yet'.

meaning.ok: content hash unchanged since the previous run
meaning.new: first snapshot taken; nothing to compare yet
meaning.drifted: the official page changed but none of the values this site depends on changed
meaning.changed: a value this site depends on changed - re-run scripts/build-events.py and review the row
meaning.pattern-missing: a tracked pattern no longer matches: the page was redesigned or the clause was removed
meaning.error: the official URL could not be read; the last verified value stays on the site with its old date
meaning.error-new: the official URL could not be read and no baseline exists yet
